passing_test_names: [legacy_shapes] direct and wrapped inputs preserve one normalized event and distinct raw evidence
[legacy_shapes] wrapper-only rich fields and wrapper extensions survive the recorded request
[legacy_shapes] canonical producer aliases agree with legacy identity without manufacturing authentication
[internal_event] records exactly the internal engine_handoff request while preserving final destination
[internal_event] unsupported ingress or stage does not silently select the accepted contract
[conflicting_target] contradictory route declarations hold and preserve their original evidence
[conflicting_target] missing target cannot be inferred from the route stage alone
[conflicting_target] conflicting rich wrapper and event data is held rather than overwritten
[conflicting_target] identical double declarations of rich data do not create a false conflict
[missing_provenance] absent, null, or blank required producer fields hold without local substitution
[missing_provenance] caller request identity is required and never replaced by a diagnostic identity
[missing_provenance] disagreeing canonical and legacy producer identities are explicit holds
[missing_provenance] invalid or timezone-free timestamps do not gain authority through Date.parse coercion
[missing_provenance] malformed JSON and non-object roots are held before fake transport
[missing_provenance] duplicate JSON keys are rejected at the root, nested, and escaped-name boundaries
[failure_status] failure-bearing labels never normalize to progress or completion
[non_success] incomplete, partial, skipped, blocked, and unknown outcomes remain non-success
[non_success] non-string status values are held without truthy coercion
[non_success] an exact producer completion report does not become verified receiver completion
[identity_collision] same request identity with changed rich content collides without a second request
[identity_collision] byte changes collide even when parsed JSON values are equivalent
[identity_collision] route decision and ingress are included in the request identity binding
[duplicate] identical repeats are explicit local duplicates and keep the prior observation
[duplicate] fake HTTP rejection and fake error are not retried by an identical repeat
[duplicate] a hold with complete declared identity reserves its request without attempting transport
[duplicate] a missing declared producer namespace cannot reserve or fabricate request identity
[duplicate] equal request IDs from distinct declared producer repositories are separate local identities
[transport_only] HTTP 204 means fake transport acceptance with no receiver execution or artifact
[transport_only] every other fake HTTP status remains rejected, including other 2xx statuses
[transport_only] fake transport exceptions retain an error outcome without a success label
[transport_only] returned request snapshots cannot mutate recorded fake transport evidence
[missing_receiver] selecting Tyme-Lab holds before even the available fake 204 response
[missing_receiver] Tyme-Lab as a producer or text value is not mistaken for a selected destination
[missing_receiver] another unreviewed destination is held rather than accepted because a map entry exists
R01: conflicting legacy source cannot survive repo normalization
R02: consistent legacy source is preserved; source alone cannot fill repo
R03: non-null workflow and AVOT destination selectors require a reviewed meaning
R04: null workflow and AVOT selectors remain unspecified, preserved values
R05: literal lone surrogates are rejected before a misleading byte digest exists
R06: escaped surrogate JSON sequences retain distinct exact-byte identities
R07: well-formed astral Unicode survives request preservation
R08: nonobject API inputs produce structured holds without fabricated provenance
R09: an external mutation cannot alter the configured observation clock
R10: wrapper-only source_event is held instead of becoming legacy producer evidence

baseline_check.note: Standalone archives contain candidate files, not repository source copies. Unavailable sources are not claimed as verified.

limitations: Tests exercise the isolated local candidate, not the unchanged GitHub workflows.
All transport responses are built-in in-memory simulations; no live dispatch is performed.
Producer identity is declared, not authenticated; credentials and App ID binding are unverified.
Destination metadata does not establish a live AVOT-engine or Tyme-Lab receiver.
The ledger is per harness instance, with no durable, cross-instance or remote exactly-once guarantee.
No receiver run, returned artifact, institutional receipt or promotion is established.
